import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    missing = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL", "None"]

    return raw.select(
        employee_id=pl.col("id").str.strip_chars().replace(missing, None).str.to_uppercase(),
        employee_name=(
            pl.col("name.first").str.strip_chars().replace(missing, None)
            + " "
            + pl.col("name.last").str.strip_chars().replace(missing, None)
        ),
        work_date=pl.col("entries.date")
        .str.strip_chars()
        .replace(missing, None)
        .str.to_date("%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        project_code=pl.col("entries.project")
        .str.strip_chars()
        .replace(missing, None)
        .str.to_uppercase(),
        hours_normal=pl.col("entries.normal")
        .str.strip_chars()
        .replace(missing, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        hours_overtime=pl.col("entries.overtime")
        .str.strip_chars()
        .replace(missing, None)
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
    )
